answer: Bind each agent to a single onyx identity card that costs a small refundable stake and cannot be duplicated or sold, so fabricating many fake identities gets expensive fast. Reputation then accrues like yarrow: only slow, public, independently verified work counts, and old endorsements fade unless renewed by fresh contributions. Finally, a velvet audit lottery randomly re-checks a sample of identities each epoch, stripping stake and reputation from any cluster found sharing keys or voting together. Sybils fail because mass fabrication is costly, slow, and likely to be caught.
